title: Design System: J&J Garage Doors LLC

display.purpose: Hero H1 only; white on the photo, last phrase gold on its own line; bounces in letter by letter.

headline.purpose: Section H2s; last phrase may be accent-coloured.

title.purpose: Cal Sans for tappable and list labels: service rows, claims, steps, Facebook row, field labels, button labels, phone numbers.

lede.purpose: The line under a section heading; the hero promise is the same role.

body.purpose: Running text and inputs at 16px/1.7 in the system stack.

textures.name: deep-lines
textures.purpose: Deep navy bands (How it works, footer); keep at or under ~4% white.

overlays.name: hero-overlay-phone
overlays.purpose: Navy over the full-bleed hero photo on phones and tablets.

overlays.name: hero-overlay-desktop
overlays.purpose: From 1024px: the photo takes the right 62%, solid deep navy holds the words on the left.

motion.name: letter-in
motion.value: 1s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) forwards; delay calc(var(--i) * 20ms); from opacity:0 translateX(50px)
motion.purpose: Hero H1 bounce-in only; skipped under reduced motion and without JS; plain H1 restored on animationend.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Fade-up for .rise elements that start below the first screen.

motion.name: pick
motion.purpose: Gold flash on a chip a service row just selected.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: min-width; split layouts, three-column rows and steps

bilingual.mechanism: Paired <span class="en"> / <span class="es" lang="es"> for every string; html[data-lang] hides the inactive one. Head script sets language before paint from localStorage 'jj-lang' or navigator.language. Toggle also swaps data-ph-en/es placeholders, data-alt-es image alt, SMS bodies, float aria-label and the composed form message.

components.css: :host{--paper:#f4f6fb;--card:#fff;--field:#e6ecf5;--ink:#0d2138;--soft:#4a5868;--navy:#183a63;--deep:#0d2138;--on-dark:#f4f7fb;--on-dark-soft:#c9d4e3;--gold:#f3b324;--gold-2:#ffc845;--gold-ink:#7a5400;--focus:#1f5fa8;--error:#b3261e;--display:'Cal Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--r-card:24px;--r-field:10px;--pill:999px} .ds-navy{background:var(--navy);padding:24px} .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:64px;padding:10px 12px 10px 22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:18px;color:var(--on-dark);text-decoration:none;font:400 20px/1.2 var(--display)} .ds-row:hover,.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);box-shadow:none} .ds-arrow{width:44px;height:44px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--on-dark);transition:background-color .2s,color .2s} .ds-row:hover .ds-arrow{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)} .ds-row:focus-visible .ds-arrow{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: :host{--paper:#f4f6fb;--card:#fff;--field:#e6ecf5;--ink:#0d2138;--soft:#4a5868;--navy:#183a63;--deep:#0d2138;--on-dark:#f4f7fb;--on-dark-soft:#c9d4e3;--gold:#f3b324;--gold-2:#ffc845;--gold-ink:#7a5400;--focus:#1f5fa8;--error:#b3261e;--display:'Cal Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--r-card:24px;--r-field:10px;--pill:999px} .ds-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;background:var(--card);padding:20px;border-radius:var(--r-card)} .ds-chips input{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;margin:0} .ds-chips label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:var(--pill);background:var(--field);border:2px solid transparent;font:16px/1 var(--text);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background-color .15s,color .15s} .ds-chips label:hover{border-color:var(--focus)} .ds-chips input:focus-visible+label{border-color:var(--focus);outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px} .ds-chips input:checked+label{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}

components.css: :host{--paper:#f4f6fb;--card:#fff;--field:#e6ecf5;--ink:#0d2138;--soft:#4a5868;--navy:#183a63;--deep:#0d2138;--on-dark:#f4f7fb;--on-dark-soft:#c9d4e3;--gold:#f3b324;--gold-2:#ffc845;--gold-ink:#7a5400;--focus:#1f5fa8;--error:#b3261e;--display:'Cal Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--r-card:24px;--r-field:10px;--pill:999px} .ds-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;min-height:76px;padding:0 20px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)} .ds-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;line-height:1} .ds-mark{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 9px var(--ink),inset 0 0 0 30px var(--gold)} .ds-brand b{display:block;font:400 24px/1 var(--display)} .ds-brand small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font:600 11px/1 var(--text);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--soft)} .ds-lang{margin-left:auto;min-height:44px;padding:0 6px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--soft);font:500 15px/1 var(--text);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px} .ds-lang:hover{color:var(--ink)} .ds-tel{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;font:400 20px/1 var(--display);text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap} .ds-tel:hover{color:var(--gold-ink)} .ds-lang:focus-visible,.ds-tel:focus-visible,.ds-brand:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}

components.css: :host{--paper:#f4f6fb;--card:#fff;--field:#e6ecf5;--ink:#0d2138;--soft:#4a5868;--navy:#183a63;--deep:#0d2138;--on-dark:#f4f7fb;--on-dark-soft:#c9d4e3;--gold:#f3b324;--gold-2:#ffc845;--gold-ink:#7a5400;--focus:#1f5fa8;--error:#b3261e;--display:'Cal Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--r-card:24px;--r-field:10px;--pill:999px} .ds-steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:28px;display:grid;gap:24px;counter-reset:s;background-color:var(--deep);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0 22px,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 22px 23px);color:var(--on-dark-soft);font:16px/1.7 var(--text)} .ds-steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr;gap:16px;counter-increment:s} .ds-steps li::before{content:counter(s);width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);font:400 20px/1 var(--display)} .ds-steps b{display:block;font:400 21px/1.2 var(--display);color:var(--on-dark);margin-top:4px} .ds-steps span{display:block;margin-top:4px}

components.css: :host{--paper:#f4f6fb;--card:#fff;--field:#e6ecf5;--ink:#0d2138;--soft:#4a5868;--navy:#183a63;--deep:#0d2138;--on-dark:#f4f7fb;--on-dark-soft:#c9d4e3;--gold:#f3b324;--gold-2:#ffc845;--gold-ink:#7a5400;--focus:#1f5fa8;--error:#b3261e;--display:'Cal Sans','Avenir Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--r-card:24px;--r-field:10px;--pill:999px} .ds-stage{position:relative;height:120px;background:var(--paper)} .ds-float{position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:16px;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(8,22,40,.3)} .ds-float:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The page is a stack of full-bleed bands that alternate off-white paper with two night navies, so each new section is obvious without rules or boxes. One of J&J's own job photos (two black doors on a gray house) sits under a navy overlay in the hero. The logo's gold is the only warm colour on the page. It is a fill: buttons, the arrow circle on hover, step numbers, the floating text circle. Almost everything is borderless and softly rounded. Depth comes from moving between bands, not from shadows.

The tone is a family crew that takes its time. One webfont (Cal Sans) handles every heading and every tappable label, the system stack carries running text at a relaxed 16/1.7, and motion appears only twice: the hero headline bounces in letter by letter, and content below the first screen rises 12px as it arrives. The page is bilingual (English and Spanish) as a whole: both languages are in the markup, and one attribute on `<html>` decides which is shown.

This is the pitch-site house "calm band style" (after lpmr.co.uk), using this client's logo colours and photo. An earlier liftable-door world for this project is retired and is in git history only. Don't mix the two.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed bands in this order: paper header, photo hero, paper, navy, paper, deep navy with line texture, paper, navy, deep footer.
Gold is used as a fill. On light ground, gold as text is the darker gold-ink.
Cal Sans 400 for headings and tappable labels (buttons, rows, field labels, phone numbers); system sans for body text.
Borderless soft shapes: 24px cards, 18px rows, 10px fields, full pills.
Flat surfaces. The only shadow is on the floating text circle.
Two motions: the hero H1 letter bounce-in and a 12px fade-up. Both are off under reduced motion and without JS.

rules.name: The Gold Is a Fill Rule
rules.body: Gold (#f3b324) appears as a fill with Ink text on it. On light ground it never appears as text. Use Gold Ink there. On navy it may colour an accent phrase or a glyph.

rules.name: The Accent on Hover Rule
rules.body: Interactive accents start out neutral. The arrow circle is a faint white tint at rest and turns gold only on hover or focus.

rules.name: The Two Outline Colours Rule
rules.body: Focus rings are Form Blue on light ground and Gold on navy, deep and hero bands. No third ring colour.

rules.name: The One Face, One Weight Rule
rules.body: Cal Sans is only ever set at 400, and size alone carries the hierarchy. Don't add a bold weight or a second display face.

rules.name: The Tappable in Display Rule
rules.body: Anything a thumb presses (buttons, rows, the phone number, field labels) is set in Cal Sans. Body copy and helper text stay in system sans.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the floating text circle has a shadow. Cards, rows, buttons and the form card stay flat. Rows and the Facebook row explicitly set `box-shadow: none` on hover.

dos: Do alternate full-bleed bands (paper, navy, deep with texture) so each section boundary is a band change.
Do use gold (#f3b324) only as a fill with Ink text on it; use gold-ink (#7a5400) when gold has to be text on light ground.
Do set headings and every tappable label in Cal Sans 400; keep body in the system stack at 16px/1.7.
Do give every form control (text fields, chips, the form's submit) a Form Blue (#1f5fa8) outline on hover and focus; keep error borders red even while focused.
Do keep the hero to an eyebrow, the H1 with the place in it, one promise line and at most two pill buttons (gold primary, outlined ghost).
Do keep the phone number top right in the header on the first screen, and repeat it only in the close band and footer.
Do put the Facebook row directly under the work photo, and again in the footer.
Do show all content at rest, without JS and under reduced motion; the bounce-in is for the hero H1 only.
Do ship every string in both English and Spanish spans.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or larger.
donts: Don't outline, ring, tint or shadow a service row or the Facebook row on hover or focus; only the arrow circle changes.
Don't add a sticky bottom bar or a Call button under the hero title; the single floating text circle is the only fixed control.
Don't put gold text on paper, white text on gold, or gold as a focus ring on light ground.
Don't add shadows to cards, rows or buttons; the float is the one lifted object.
Don't add captions under photos, a lead-in sentence above the work photo, or a services list in the hero.
Don't make non-interactive labels (service areas, towns, claims) look like pills or buttons.
Don't stretch or upscale photos; `object-fit: cover` at the photo's own shape.
Don't let the deep-band texture rise above about 4% white, so no line ever reads through text.
Don't bring back the retired liftable-door world's devices; this project's world is the calm band style.
